gloss.info: indicating an item near the speaker, the action of the speaker, or the current topic
usu. indicating someone in one's in-group
as これから, これまで, etc.

gloss.gloss: used to stress the subject of a sentence
indicates contrast with another option (stated or unstated)

gloss.info: prohibitive; used with dictionary form of verb
imperative; used with -masu stem of verb
used to get someone's attention or press one's point

gloss.gloss: now, ...; well, ...; I tell you!; you know
gloss.info: when seeking confirmation, for emphasis, etc.; used at sentence end
used to express admiration, emotionality, etc.; used at sentence end

gloss.gloss: right?; isn't it?; doesn't it?; don't you?; don't you think?
gloss.info: used as a request for confirmation or agreement; used at sentence end
after the root of an adjective
abbr. of particle の; indicates possessive
abbr. of particle に, used esp. when it precedes the verb なる
